A small slice of published data: three of the 50 humpback whales (Megaptera novaeangliae) in
Movebank study 3030068329, "Movements of Australia's east coast humpback whales". Data package:
Andrews-Goff V, Gales N, Childerhouse S, Laverick S, Polanowski A, Double M (2023), Movebank Data
Repository, https://doi.org/10.5441/001/1.294 (CC0 1.0). Paper: Biodiversity Data Journal 11:
e114729, https://doi.org/10.3897/BDJ.11.e114729.

- `locations.csv`: every row of whales 53383 (adult male), 96404 (adult, sex unknown) and 98109
  (calf, female) from the study's locations file: raw Argos fixes (three flagged as outliers,
  `visible` = false) and state-space model estimates (`modelled` = true).
- `reference-data.csv`: their three rows of the reference data.

Both are unchanged except for the rows left out.
